name: Minesweeper By rsaw409
_comment_appVersionCode: Historical only — 4 was the last versionCode published via PWABuilder. The real Play Store versionCode is computed by CI as VERSION_CODE_BASE + workflow run number (see .github/workflows/release.yml) and always overwrites this value at build time. Don't bump this field expecting it to ship.
_comment_appVersion: User-visible version name (Play Store 'version name'). This one you DO bump by hand for a real release — nothing else changes it.
_comment_minSdkVersion: Oldest Android API level the app installs on. NOT the field Play Store nags you about yearly — that's targetSdkVersion, a different, unrelated setting (see below). Only lower/raise this to change the floor of supported devices.
_comment_targetAndCompileSdkVersion: targetSdkVersion/compileSdkVersion (currently 36/36, generated into app/build.gradle) are NOT set anywhere in this file — Bubblewrap has no manifest field for them. Each Bubblewrap release bundles its own values, and CI regenerates the whole Android project from this manifest using a PINNED Bubblewrap CLI version (BUBBLEWRAP_VERSION in .github/workflows/release.yml). THIS is the field Play Store requires bumping roughly every year — when that happens, bump BUBBLEWRAP_VERSION there (in its own reviewed change), not minSdkVersion or anything in this file.
